meta.name: dev-external-context
meta.description: Parallel external documentation lookup. Spawn multiple @scroll-docs agents simultaneously to fetch SDK refs, API docs, and framework guides for different topics in one pass.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 并行查询多个外部文档，一次获取多份参考资料
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要同时查阅多个SDK或API文档
copy.tagline_en: Query multiple external docs in parallel, fetching references at once
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to consult multiple SDK or API docs simultaneously

howto.what: 当需要同时查找多个独立的外部文档（如不同SDK、API或框架指南）时，Claude会并行启动多个@scroll-docs代理分别查询，然后将结果整合成一份包含对比和推荐的研究报告。
howto.when: 当任务要求至少3个不同主题的外部文档查询，或时间紧迫需要并行查找时触发。

say.text: 帮我同时查一下React和Vue的官方API文档。
对比AWS Lambda和Azure Functions最新SDK的差异。
say.note: 同时启动两个查询，最后比较结果。

howto.what_en: When the task needs multiple independent external doc lookups, Claude spawns @scroll-docs agents in parallel for each topic, then synthesizes into a combined report with comparisons and recommendations.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the task requires 3+ different topic lookups, or when time-sensitive research benefits from parallelism.

say_en.text: Look up React and Vue official API docs simultaneously.
Compare AWS Lambda and Azure Functions latest SDKs.
Search Python async frameworks aiohttp, FastAPI, Tornado docs in parallel.
say_en.note: Three parallel lookups for each framework.
